stories.title: Mumbai techie looking for extra income through WFH job loses Rs 90.8L, makes 525 UPI transfers to fraudsters over 3 years, even uses father's pension before threats of arrest, morphed photos push her to register FIR
stories.summary: A Bhandup woman fell victim to a work-from-home data-entry scam, losing Rs 90.8 lakh. After responding to a job advertisement on Instagram, she was manipulated into making numerous payments. The accused threatened her with fake police actions and defamation using morphed images.
